title: The Bee and Jupiter
summary: A queen bee offered fresh honey to the sovereign of the skies, begging for a weapon to kill anyone who approached her hive....
full_text:
A queen bee offered fresh honey to the sovereign of the skies, begging for a weapon to kill anyone who approached her hive.

Displeased with her spiteful malice, the sovereign granted her a venomous sting, but decreed that whenever she stung, her sting would remain in the wound, costing the bee her own life.
moral: Malicious prayers intended to harm others recoil upon the petitioner.
